title: Out-of-scope search probes for abstain calibration
purpose: Bilingual queries that no registered Operation can serve. capabilities_search must return no executable candidate (abstain) for each. Authored without inspecting any search score. Categories: non_geometry, other_library, unsupported_cgal (geometric tasks that CGAL offers elsewhere or that the registry does not cover), vague_or_decorative.
authoring: Written by the implementing agent before any abstain feature was computed; the 6 out_of_scope_intents of search_blind_set_2.json are used in addition. These probes are a development set for the abstain threshold (cross-validated), not a blind set.
